scripts.setup: yarn run setup:dependencies && yarn run setup:ios && echo '✅ Setup completado. Ejecuta: yarn run ios o yarn run android'
scripts.setup:ios: cd ios && pod setup && pod install --repo-update && pod update && cd ..
scripts.clean: yarn cache clean && rm -rf node_modules && yarn install
scripts.clean:ios: cd ios && rm -rf Pods Podfile.lock build && pod deintegrate && pwd && cd ..
scripts.deep-clean: yarn run clean:android && yarn run clean:ios && watchman watch-del-all && yarn install
scripts.clean:full: watchman watch-del-all && yarn cache clean && rm -rf node_modules yarn.lock && cd ios && rm -rf Pods Podfile.lock build && pod deintegrate && cd ../android && rm -rf app/build app/.cxx .gradle build && cd .. && rm -rf ~/Library/Caches/CocoaPods ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/*
scripts.ios-rebuild: yarn run clean:ios && yarn run setup:ios
scripts.android-build-qa: yarn run clean:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd ..
scripts.android-build-prod: yarn run clean:android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease && cd ..
